module.purpose: Provides client-side factories that decode React Server Component Flight streams and expose the decoded content through RSC proxies.
module.summary: This client-only module decodes readable Flight streams using the browser RSC decoder, waits for lazy elements, unwraps CSS metadata envelopes, and caches the resulting tree. It exposes separate renderable and composite proxy factories, supports CSS and JavaScript preload metadata, tracks post-processing promises, and preserves the original stream through a replay wrapper.
module.businessContext: Supports server-rendered React component delivery in TanStack Start applications. Failure prevents streamed server components, nested composite access, lazy resource loading, and associated preload handling from rendering correctly.
classes: StreamDecodeOptions (~L16-19): Optional CSS and JavaScript preload metadata for stream decoding
functions: createRenderableFromStream (~L30-45): Creates a directly renderable proxy around decoded server component content
createCompositeFromStream (~L56-74): Creates a non-renderable composite proxy from a server component stream
setupStreamDecode (~L79-136): Configures shared decoding, lazy loading, caching, and stream wrapping
startDecode (~L99-118): Starts one shared asynchronous decode and lazy-element processing operation
getTree (~L129-133): Returns cached decoded content or suspends through the decode promise

module.moduleLevelCode:
'use client'

import { use } from 'react'
import { trackPostProcessPromise } from '@tanstack/start-client-core'
import { createFromReadableStream as browserDecode } from 'virtual:tanstack-rsc-browser-decode'

import { awaitLazyElements } from './awaitLazyElements'
import { createRscProxy } from './createRscProxy'
import { unwrapRscCssEnvelope } from './rscCssEnvelope'
import type {
  AnyCompositeComponent,
  RscSlotUsageEvent,
  ServerComponentStream,
} from './ServerComponentTypes'

units.name: createRenderableFromStream

detail.name: createRenderableFromStream
preconditions: stream is a ReadableStream<Uint8Array> accepted by the stream decoder.
options, when provided, conforms to StreamDecodeOptions.
postconditions: Returns the renderable proxy produced from the stream decoder.
The proxy is configured with the decoder's stream wrapper, CSS hrefs, JavaScript preloads, and renderable=true.
invariants: The input stream and decoding options are passed to setupStreamDecode.
The decoder result is passed to createRscProxy without changing its stream, CSS, or JavaScript preload values.
edgeCases: When options is omitted, setupStreamDecode is invoked with only the stream argument and the resulting proxy is still marked renderable.
Decoder or proxy-construction failures are not caught by this function and propagate to the caller.

errorPolicy.onInvalidInput: Not handled locally; errors from stream decoding or proxy construction propagate.

stateMutations: Passes the stream to setupStreamDecode, which may establish decoder state and consume the stream.
detail.summary: Creates and returns a renderable RSC proxy backed by a byte stream and optional stream-decoding options. The returned proxy exposes the decoded stream together with its CSS and JavaScript preload metadata.

specTests.then: It returns a proxy configured with the decoder's stream wrapper, cssHrefs, and jsPreloads, and the proxy configuration has renderable set to true.

units.name: createCompositeFromStream

detail.name: createCompositeFromStream
detail.signature: export function createCompositeFromStream(stream: ReadableStream<Uint8Array>, options?: { slotUsagesStream?: ReadableStream<RscSlotUsageEvent> } & StreamDecodeOptions): AnyCompositeComponent
preconditions: If provided, options conforms to the declared StreamDecodeOptions intersection and its slotUsagesStream is a ReadableStream<RscSlotUsageEvent>.
postconditions: Returns an AnyCompositeComponent created with the decoded stream wrapper, CSS hrefs, JavaScript preloads, and renderable set to false.
The provided slotUsagesStream, when present, is forwarded to the returned component proxy.
invariants: The source stream is passed to stream decoding before the composite proxy is created.
The returned proxy is configured as non-renderable.
edgeCases: When options is omitted, decoding options are omitted and no slotUsagesStream is forwarded.
When options includes slotUsagesStream, that stream is included in the returned proxy configuration.
Errors raised while setting up stream decoding or creating the proxy are not handled by this function.
detail.summary: Creates a composite RSC component proxy backed by a readable stream and configured stream-decoding options. The returned proxy exposes the decoded component tree and associated CSS, JavaScript preload, and optional slot-usage stream data.

units.name: setupStreamDecode

detail.name: setupStreamDecode
detail.signature: function setupStreamDecode(stream: ReadableStream<Uint8Array>, options?: StreamDecodeOptions): { getTree: () => unknown; streamWrapper: ServerComponentStream; cssHrefs: Set<string>; jsPreloads: Set<string> | undefined }
detail.returnType: { getTree: () => unknown; streamWrapper: ServerComponentStream; cssHrefs: Set<string>; jsPreloads: Set<string> | undefined }
preconditions: stream is a ReadableStream<Uint8Array> compatible with browserDecode.
postconditions: Returns a getTree function, a streamWrapper whose createReplayStream method returns the supplied stream, a copied CSS href Set, and an optional copied JavaScript preload Set.
The decoded tree is cached after browserDecode and awaitLazyElements complete successfully.
CSS hrefs discovered while awaiting lazy elements are added to the returned cssHrefs Set.
invariants: Decoding is initiated at most once for the supplied stream.
The returned cssHrefs Set is initialized from options.cssHrefs without mutating the original iterable or array.
When options.jsPreloads is truthy, jsPreloads is a new Set containing its values; otherwise jsPreloads is undefined.
Once the decoded tree cache is ready, getTree returns the cached tree synchronously.
The stream wrapper always returns the original stream from createReplayStream.
edgeCases: With no options, or with empty CSS and JavaScript preload collections, decoding starts eagerly during setup.
With one or more initial CSS hrefs, decoding is deferred until getTree initiates it.
With a non-empty JavaScript preload collection, decoding is deferred until getTree initiates it.
If decoding or lazy-element processing fails, the associated promise rejects and the tree cache is not marked ready.
Repeated calls to getTree reuse the single decode promise and do not start a second decode.

errorPolicy.onInvalidInput: Errors raised by browserDecode or awaitLazyElements propagate through the decode promise; no fallback tree is produced.

stateMutations: Mutates the internally created cssHrefs Set by adding hrefs discovered during lazy-element processing.
Initializes the internally captured transformedTreePromise at most once.
Updates the internally captured cachedTree and cacheReady state after successful decoding and lazy-element processing.
Registers the decode promise with trackPostProcessPromise.
detail.summary: Creates a stream-backed decoder facade that exposes the decoded component tree, a replayable stream wrapper, and collected CSS and JavaScript preload references. Decoding starts eagerly unless CSS or JavaScript preload inputs require deferred decoding.

specTests.then: The returned cssHrefs is an empty Set, jsPreloads is undefined, decoding is initiated eagerly, and streamWrapper.createReplayStream() returns the supplied stream.

specTests.when: setupStreamDecode is called before getTree is invoked.
specTests.then: Decoding is deferred; the returned CSS and JavaScript collections are independent Sets initialized with the option values.

specTests.when: getTree is invoked and decoding completes.
specTests.then: The decoded tree is returned, reported hrefs are present in cssHrefs, and subsequent getTree calls reuse the cached tree without initiating another decode.

units.name: startDecode

detail.name: startDecode
preconditions: The enclosing stream decoder state and stream are initialized.
postconditions: A promise for the transformed tree is returned.
The decode operation is initialized at most once.
After successful lazy-element processing, the transformed tree is cached and cache readiness is marked true.
The decode promise is registered for post-processing tracking.
invariants: All calls return the same transformed-tree promise after initialization.
The stream is decoded only once.
The cache is marked ready only after lazy elements have been awaited and the CSS envelope has been unwrapped.
edgeCases: On the first call, decoding, lazy-element loading, CSS reference collection, envelope unwrapping, caching, and post-processing tracking are initiated.
On subsequent calls before completion, no additional decode or tracking operation is started and the original pending promise is returned.
On subsequent calls after completion, the already-resolved promise is returned.
If decoding or lazy-element processing rejects, the returned promise rejects and no successful cached-tree completion is established.

errorPolicy.returnsOnError: Propagates rejection from stream decoding or lazy-element processing through the returned promise.

stateMutations: Adds CSS hrefs discovered during lazy-element processing to cssHrefs.
Sets cachedTree after successful decoding and lazy-element processing.
Sets cacheReady to true after cachedTree is assigned.
detail.summary: Starts decoding the associated stream once and returns the shared promise for the transformed tree. Subsequent calls reuse the same in-progress or completed decode operation.

specTests.when: startDecode() is called twice before the first promise settles.
specTests.then: Both calls return the same promise, and only one stream decode operation is initiated.

specTests.when: The promise returned by startDecode() settles.
specTests.then: It resolves to the unwrapped transformed tree, cacheReady is true, and the resulting tree is cached.

units.name: getTree

detail.name: getTree
preconditions: The closure variables cacheReady, cachedTree, and startDecode are available.
postconditions: When cacheReady is true, returns cachedTree without invoking startDecode or use.
When cacheReady is false, invokes startDecode and returns the result of use applied to its result.
invariants: The cached-tree path and the decode path are mutually exclusive for each invocation.
edgeCases: If cacheReady is true, the current cachedTree value is returned directly.
If cacheReady is false, any value, suspension, or error produced by startDecode or use is propagated according to those dependencies.
detail.summary: Returns the cached decoded tree when decoding is ready; otherwise obtains the tree through the decode-start operation and React's suspense-aware use mechanism.

specTests.then: It returns cachedTree directly and does not require starting decoding.
It starts decoding and returns the value obtained by passing the decode result to use.
